name: lintel-workspace
description: npm workspaces for the Lintel developer packages (SDK, MCP server, starter, examples). The engine, relay and app build on their own.

scripts.build: npm run build -w lintel-sdk && npm run build -w lintel-mcp
scripts.test: npm test -w lintel-sdk && npm test -w lintel-mcp && npm test -w create-lintel-app
